## Behavior and acceptance
Given a project exported from Babulus with source, assets, generated speech, timing, fonts/dependency versions, and render settings, when opened by the open VideoML CLI on a supported machine, then it renders without a Babulus account or proprietary-only data. Compare representative frames/audio timing within recorded tolerances. Babulus accepts the same portable input and returns downloadable artifacts; no required HeyGen or Babulus hosted dependency in the standard.

## Ownership
Babulus rendering platform; VideoML public project/artifact contract

## Verification
Specify Given/When/Then fixtures before implementation and link results before closing. This issue is planned work, not a claim of shipped functionality.
